brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Keep sewing supplies tidy - organized compartmentalized storage
requirements.evidence: 3 connected hex bases (piece:0,0,0; piece:0,-1,0; piece:0,1,0 with jointBolts) with divided bins: hex-bin-full-div2 at center (2 compartments), hex-bin-full-div3 at both ends (3 compartments each) = 8 total compartments for threads, needles, buttons, etc. MeshClash clear

finish.summary: Built linear 3-cell organizer with compartmentalized bins: 2-compartment div2 in center and 3-compartment div3 on each end, joined with joint bolts for stability - ideal for sorting sewing supplies.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
